AI 101 in plain English
The five terms every BNI member should know.
AI
Artificial Intelligence
The simulation of human intelligence in machines designed to think, learn, and solve problems. It relies on data, algorithms and computing power — from image recognition to natural language processing.
GPT
Generative Pre-trained Transformer
A family of AI models that can generate human-like text. GPT models are a type of large language model that use deep learning to process and analyze large amounts of text data.
LLM
Large Language Model
A model trained on massive amounts of text so it can understand and generate human-like text, translate languages and answer questions with high fluency.
ML
Machine Learning
The core technology that learns patterns from existing data and then uses them to generate new content — text, images or audio.
LAM
Large Action Model ("Agentic")
An AI system that not only understands a request but actively takes action on it — performing tasks and interacting with systems to execute what you asked.

What isn't AI? AI is not a sentient being or a "thinking" entity. It has no consciousness, emotions or self-awareness. It executes tasks and learns patterns, but cannot independently "decide" or "desire" without human-defined objectives. It is a tool, not a replacement for human intuition or creativity. Well, at least not yet.

AI safety & privacy
Protecting your business and clients.

As businesses adopt AI tools for automation and efficiency, data security and privacy are critical. AI can streamline operations, improve decision-making and enhance customer interactions — but improper use can expose sensitive information, leading to intellectual property (IP) theft, data breaches and regulatory violations.

What NOT to share with AI tools

⛔

Trade secrets & IP

Avoid inputting proprietary business strategies, unpublished research, or sensitive product details.
⛔

Client & customer data

Never share names, contact details, financial records, or personal identifiers.
⛔

Internal company documents

Do not upload contracts, financial statements, employee records, or business reports.
⛔

Passwords & credentials

Never input login information, API keys, or security codes into AI systems.

GDPR compliance & data protection

Minimize data collection
Only collect and store data that is absolutely necessary.
Secure user consent
Obtain explicit consent before processing personal data.
Right to access & deletion
Users may request access to their data or have it deleted.
Storage limitations
Implement secure data storage and encryption measures.

When using AI, make sure models do not store, process, or share personal data without proper compliance mechanisms in place.

🤝 BNI rules on client privacy & confidentiality

  • Never share client contact details or business information in AI systems or with other members unless explicitly authorized.
  • Maintain confidentiality in referrals — shared information stays private and within ethical guidelines.
  • Follow BNI's ethical standards: trust, integrity, and professional conduct when handling sensitive data.

What is an AI prompt?
A prompt is the input you give an AI model. It sets the context, defines the task and guides the response. It can be a single word, a question, or a paragraph — and its design drastically influences the quality and relevance of the output.
Clarity
Specificity
Context
SIMPLE PROMPT

“Tell me about BNI.”

BETTER PROMPT

“Write a persuasive email to potential clients highlighting the key benefits of BNI and our referral strategies, emphasizing its beneficial features and affordability, targeting small businesses.”

The seven basic actions
1

Writing

Documents, emails…
2

Summarizing

Reduce word count, digestible information
3

Brainstorming

Generate new ideas and content
4

Synthesizing

Find trends, pull out insights and take-aways from a body of evidence
5

Extracting

Data, data cleaning, manipulation
6

Reformatting

Data and text clean-up, new layouts
7

Coding

Write programming code
Your go-to prompt frameworks
Three styles — RTF, GCSE and RACEF.
RTF

Role · Task · Format

Perfect for smaller tasks

Role
Define the persona you want AI to act as.
"Act as a marketing director."
Task
Tell AI what you need it to do.
"Create a checklist for onboarding new employees."
Format
Explain how you want the output delivered.
"Deliver the checklist as a Word document with headers and bullet points."

Example: You are a content strategist, create a social media plan to launch a new eco-friendly product and highlight them as a series of bullet points.

GCSE

Goal · Context · Specifics · Expectations

Clear specifications across key dimensions

Example: Generate 3-5 bullet points to prepare me for a meeting with Client X to discuss their 'Phase 3 - brand campaign'. Client X is launching the third phase of their brand campaign aimed at increasing market visibility. Focus on Email and Teams chats since June. Please use simple language so I can get up to speed quickly.

RACEF

Role · Action · Content · Examples · Format

Your go-to framework — add more detail, get better results

Role
You are a world-class copywriter
Action
Write a blog announcing a new product
Content
[Insert lots of detail about the product]
Examples
Here are some tweets to model after: [paste]
Format
The tweet should be 3 lines, with no emojis

Example: Act like a [ROLE]. I need a [NEED]. You will [ACTION], in the process. You should [CONTENT / Details]. Please [DO NOT…]. Here is an example: [EXAMPLES…]. Present the final result in a [FORMAT].

Sample AI response — Visitor Day invitation
Generated from the invitation prompt (event details from the webinar notes).
Subject: Invitation to BNI Barrett Business Builders' Visitor Day – March 27, 2025

Dear [Recipient's Name],

I hope this message finds you well. As a fellow professional dedicated to business growth and networking, I am pleased to invite you to the Visitor Day hosted by BNI Barrett Business Builders.

Event Details — Date: Thursday, March 27, 2025 · Time: 7:00 AM – 9:00 AM · Location: Governors Gun Club, 1005 Cobb Place Blvd NW, Kennesaw, GA 30144

BNI (Business Network International) is a global organization that fosters business development through structured networking and referral generation. Our chapter, Barrett Business Builders, comprises professionals across various industries who collaborate to enhance each other's business success.

Attending our Visitor Day will let you: Expand Your Network (connect with local business leaders and potential referral partners) · Gain Insights (learn effective strategies for business growth and client acquisition) · Experience BNI (observe firsthand how our structured meetings can benefit your business).

We believe your expertise in [Recipient's Industry] would add significant value to our group, and we are eager to explore potential synergies.

RSVP: Please confirm your attendance by [RSVP Deadline], either by replying to this email or contacting me directly at [Your Phone Number]. Feel free to bring business cards and any promotional materials you'd like to share. A light breakfast will be provided. Please arrive a few minutes early for registration and informal networking.

We look forward to the possibility of collaborating with you and assisting in the growth of your business.

Best regards, [Your Full Name], [Your Position] · BNI Barrett Business Builders · [Your Contact Information]

💡 Remember: AI is like a kid with all the tools but no idea what to do. Whether it's a language model or an image generator, the key is clear instructions. Be specific, descriptive, and iterative.

PUR-101 · Prospecting
Fundamentals · ⏱ 1 hr
The filter every other lead-generation habit sits on top of. Learn to score any prospect across five dimensions — Profitability, Urgency, Reachability, Engagement and Sustainability (P.U.R.E.S.). Prospects sort automatically into Tier 1A/1B/1C, so limited outreach hours go to the leads most likely to close.
SAL-101 · Prospecting
Sourcing · ⏱ 1 hr
The direct answer to "where do I find my next buyer, seller, or renter." Configure P.U.R.E.S. scoring, populate a live prospect database inside Higgins, and set service-radius, price-band and rent-range parameters — guardrails that keep outreach inside your actual footprint or budget.
